name: 1.23.0-beta.39
notes: Games from phones: a Ren'Py game's Android APK can be added like its ZIP. The app takes the game out of the APK (the files Android keeps renamed under assets/x-game) and finds which Ren'Py made it.

On phones, Add a game asks for the game's ZIP or APK (phones cannot choose folders). On computers there is also “Or choose a game's ZIP or Android APK”. An APK or ZIP shared to the app, opened with it or dropped on it is added the same way.
Big ZIPs and APKs are read a piece at a time instead of all at once, so a game of several gigabytes can be added on a phone without running out of memory (also ZIPs over 4 GB).
